description: This file contains utility functions and a class for file system operations such as creating directories, copying files, removing folders, and zipping files, primarily used within the Playwright project.

classes.name: SerializedFS
classes.description: A class that serializes file system operations such as creating directories, writing, appending, copying files, and zipping, ensuring operations are performed in order and handling errors.

methods.name: existsAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a file or directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: mkdirIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates a directory and its parent directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: removeFolders
methods.description: Removes multiple directories recursively and forcefully.

methods.name: canAccessFile
methods.description: Checks synchronously if a file can be accessed.

methods.name: copyFileAndMakeWritable
methods.description: Copies a file and sets its permissions to writable.

methods.name: sanitizeForFilePath
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe for use as a file path by replacing certain characters with hyphens.

methods.name: toPosixPath
methods.description: Converts a file path to POSIX format by replacing system-specific separators.
